# Captured GitHub CLI asset response

This fixture is the raw 2,373-byte stdout captured on 2026-10-17 from the public
`SHA256SUMS` asset (asset ID 638887099) using `gh api --include -H 'Accept:
application/octet-stream' repos/chen08209/FlClash/releases/assets/638887099`. It
contains no authorization header. The response header has an LF-only status-line
ending followed by CRLF header endings and a CRLF blank-line delimiter; the
1,517-byte body is preserved exactly.

This is a transport-format sample from the public donor repository. It is not a
Flashco release manifest and does not establish a valid Flashco release.
